description: Supplemental source-grounded retrieval evaluation for excalidraw/excalidraw.
repositoryRefStatus: Task-supplied pinned revision; snapshot has no .git metadata for independent verification.
notes: Supplemental set authored after candidate-04 source/archive freeze; it is not a pre-implementation evaluation and does not replace the existing evaluation set. Do not infer adoption, release quality, or broad generalization from this set alone.

queries.query: Where does the app debounce saving the non-deleted scene and app state to browser storage, then save image binaries separately?
queries.notes: The local persistence entrypoint coordinates both scene storage and file storage.

queries.query: How does a local .excalidraw JSON export filter out image files used only by deleted elements, and where is the resulting file saved?
queries.notes: Distinguishes standard JSON-file export from PNG embedding and clipboard serialization.

queries.query: When old diagrams are restored, where are legacy text font and line-height values repaired, and how are incomplete arrow point lists normalized?
queries.notes: Request asks for implementation; the nearby restore test is an explicit distractor.

queries.query: How is scene JSON compressed into a PNG text chunk and decoded back out, including the legacy unencoded scene case?
queries.notes: Targets PNG metadata helpers rather than the ordinary .excalidraw JSON serializer.

queries.query: How does the app map the browser language to a supported locale, fall back to the default, and cache a user selection?
queries.notes: The detector, state hook and selector are distinct steps; test file is the negative match.

queries.query: Where are collaboration scene updates encrypted before socket emission, and where are incoming packets decrypted and reconciled into the scene?
queries.notes: Separates outbound transport framing from inbound room-state handling.

queries.query: Which file manager tracks image file versions as fetching, saved or errored so repeated upload and fetch work can be deduplicated?
queries.notes: Distinguishes per-file manager bookkeeping from the shared UI status snapshot store.

queries.query: Where does the legacy localStorage library adapter load and clear saved library items as they migrate to an IndexedDB adapter, and where is that migration wired at startup?
queries.notes: App startup wires the adapters; LocalData defines both persistence adapters.

queries.query: How does this tab decide browser-stored scene or file state is newer than its in-memory version, and update the timestamp marker?
queries.notes: Targets cross-tab timestamp comparison rather than the main local save path.

queries.query: How are clipboard and drag/drop transfer items parsed when the payload mixes text and files, and how are Excalidraw element payloads recognized?
queries.notes: Implementation source is distinct from both clipboard test suites.
